card.name: Auxiliary or verb right before a main verb
card.fires_on: Auxiliary or negating words such as cannot, not, be, are, and some verbs like breaking or called, in running prose. The next word is a main verb, often a participle such as discussed, made, conducted or given.

modes.label: Negation or modal
modes.description: Words like cannot or not that come before a verb.
modes.example: The scientist wants mathematical accuracy; and when he<< cannot>> discover it, he makes it.

modes.label: Passive helper
modes.description: Be or are before a past participle in a passive clause.
modes.example: instructions may<< be>> given to reduce or omit a dose if

modes.label: Verb that takes an object or particle
modes.description: Verbs like breaking, broken or called that lead into an object or particle such as up.
modes.example: the President<< called>> his Cabinet together to consult them in regard
